solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Space travel in chaos

indicators.note: travel in chaos means the letters of travel and in are thrown into disorder and rearranged

explanation.surface: A traveller lost amid the confusion of journeying through outer space.
explanation.definitionFit: An interval is a gap or pause between two things, so a space in time or place.

clue.text: Some to choose from many a large antelope

indicators.note: some to choose from means just a portion of the following words is taken

explanation.surface: Choosing one large antelope from a herd.
explanation.definitionFit: The nyala is a spiral-horned southern African antelope.

clue.text: Inventor failing to maintain staff living conditions

indicators.note: to maintain means to hold, so the rearranged letters hold the staff inside them
failing means going wrong, so the letters of inventor are rearranged

parts.note: staff means the men, the workforce

explanation.surface: A failing inventor cannot afford to keep employees in decent conditions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Inventor failing' looks like a person in trouble, but 'failing' is the signal to rearrange the inventor's letters around the staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Environment means the surroundings or conditions in which a person or creature lives.

clue.text: Flower girl sick at heart in Romeo's home

indicators.note: in means the heart of sick goes inside the city's name

parts.note: Romeo of Romeo and Juliet lived in Verona

indicators.note: at heart means only the central letters of sick are used

explanation.surface: A girl selling flowers falls ill in Verona.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition works twice over: Veronica is a flowering plant (speedwell) and also a girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Veronica is a girl's name that is also the name of a flower, speedwell.

clue.text: Sudden awareness no great importance attaches to cry that floats up

indicators.note: attaches to means the importance word is joined on after the other pieces

parts.note: light means slight, of no great weight

indicators.note: floats up means rising, so in this down entry the word for cry is read from the bottom upward

parts.note: to blub is to cry
moment means importance, as in a matter of great moment

explanation.surface: A sudden insight is dismissed as unimportant by a person crying.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'floats up' means the word is entered bottom to top. Blub is British slang for crying.
explanation.definitionFit: A lightbulb moment is an idiom for a sudden flash of realisation or inspiration.

clue.text: Just not opening original text, leading to unease

definitions.note: plural noun answer for a mass noun; qualms are feelings of unease

indicators.note: not opening means the word loses its first letter, its opening

parts.note: just means fair, equal
MS is a manuscript, the original handwritten text

explanation.surface: A sense of fairness gone wrong from the start leaves the writer of an old manuscript uneasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Qualms are pangs of doubt or misgiving, the feeling of uneasiness about whether something is right.

clue.text: Where to dig out one's prey?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a pit where stone is excavated
second meaning: the animal or person being hunted

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests digging a hunted animal out of its burrow; the two halves are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: A quarry is an open stone pit, and also the target that a hunter pursues.

clue.text: I bore a well — its first litre

indicators.note: its first means only the opening letter of each of the next words is taken

explanation.surface: A well-digger boasts of boring a well that yields its first litre.
explanation.definitionFit: An awl is a pointed tool used for piercing holes, so it bores.

clue.text: Chap, born one of large family, is a dummy

parts.note: a chap is a man
ne is French for born, as in a man's former name
a quin is one of quintuplets, five born at once

explanation.surface: A man from a big family is mocked as an idiot.
explanation.definitionFit: A mannequin is a dummy used for displaying clothes in shop windows.

clue.text: Release document one has to vacillate about

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the vacillating word goes round the letter for one

parts.note: to vacillate is to waver
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone dithers over signing a release form.
explanation.definitionFit: A waiver is a written statement giving up a right or claim, a formal release document.

clue.text: Field boundary run exhausted energy

parts.note: to run is to go
all in is a British phrase meaning exhausted
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A tired player runs along the edge of the pitch, out of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A goal line marks the end edge of a football or rugby pitch, a boundary of the playing area.

clue.text: Queen of fish?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: Catherine ..., the sixth wife of Henry VIII

explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a title for a fishy monarch; it is two separate senses of one name.
explanation.definitionFit: Catherine Parr was Henry VIII's last queen, and a parr is a juvenile salmon in freshwater.

clue.text: Liberator of Brazil from drugs in turn corrupt

indicators.note: in means the drugs go inside the rearranged letters of turn
corrupt means spoiled, so the letters of turn are rearranged

parts.note: two drugs: crack (cocaine) and E (ecstasy)

explanation.surface: A national hero freeing Brazil from a drug trade that has gone bad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Liberator of Brazil' looks like a revolutionary hero; it is a tool that frees a Brazil nut from its shell.
explanation.definitionFit: A nutcracker cracks the shell and releases the kernel, so it sets a Brazil nut free.

clue.text: See pawn and a bishop boxed in with nowhere to move

parts.note: the letter C is pronounced like see
to hock is to pawn
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
a lock holds something boxed in and fast

explanation.surface: A chess position: a pawn and a bishop are trapped and cannot move.
explanation.definitionFit: Chock-a-block means crammed tightly together, so packed that nothing has room to shift.

clue.text: Wine Soviet intelligence secures with credit

indicators.note: secures means holds fast, so the agency's letters enclose the other pieces

parts.note: the GRU was the Soviet military intelligence agency
with means and
CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit

explanation.surface: Russian spies obtain a fine bottle on credit.
explanation.definitionFit: Grand cru is a classification for the top-rated French vineyards and the wine they produce.

clue.text: Signal pupils to assemble perhaps: sound familiar?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: literally ring a school bell to call children together
second meaning: to seem vaguely known or remembered

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase is taken once literally, at school, and once as the idiom.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring a bell is an idiom for jogging the memory, prompting something to seem known.

clue.text: Keeping a sort of light twinkling all around cell

indicators.note: all around means the whole lot is turned round and read backwards
keeping means holding, so the twinkling word holds the light inside it

parts.note: a twinkling is a moment, MO for short
UV is ultraviolet light

explanation.surface: A twinkling starlight that keeps shining all around a prison cell.
explanation.definitionFit: An ovum is an egg, the female reproductive cell.

clue.text: Gives repeat performance of scene, adapted with art

indicators.note: adapted means altered, so the letters of scene and art are rearranged

explanation.surface: An actor replays a scene, adapted with some artistry.
explanation.definitionFit: To re-enact is to act out again, staging a past event or performance once more.

clue.text: In the past, at this straightaway

definitions.meaning: first meaning: formerly, at one time
second meaning: 'at' plus this word gives at ..., meaning straightaway

explanation.walkthrough: The second half points at the answer itself: put 'at' in front of it and you have a phrase meaning straightaway.
explanation.definitionFit: Once means formerly, and the phrase at once means immediately, without delay.

clue.text: Attempted robbery, good sort of news?

parts.note: a break-in is a forced entry to steal

explanation.surface: A news bulletin asks whether a failed burglary counts as good news.
explanation.definitionFit: Breaking news is a story reported as it happens, so breaking describes one kind of news.

clue.text: After the start, rowing boat is a source of revelation

indicators.note: after the start means everything following the first letter is kept

parts.note: a coracle is a small round boat paddled by one person

explanation.surface: Setting off in a rowing boat proves an enlightening experience.
explanation.definitionFit: An oracle is a person or shrine through which divine prophecy or revelation is delivered.

clue.text: Peak stuff, something that sounds a warning

parts.note: stuff means substance, matter
a horn is sounded as a warning, as on a car

explanation.surface: On a mountain top, something sounds an alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: The Matterhorn is a famous pyramid-shaped mountain in the Alps on the Swiss-Italian border.

clue.text: On tramp, force paperwork

indicators.note: on means the force comes after the tramp, placed on to it in the across entry

parts.note: a bum is a tramp or vagrant
F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: A vagrant is made to fill in forms.
explanation.walkthrough: Bumf is British slang for tedious paperwork; a bum is a tramp.
explanation.definitionFit: Bumf is informal British slang for unwanted forms, documents and official papers.

clue.text: Red cape worn by revolutionary leader torn at the bottom

indicators.note: worn by means the cape is put on, inside the leader's name

parts.note: Mao Zedong led the Chinese revolution
C is the map abbreviation for cape

indicators.note: at the bottom means the last letter of torn, which also sits at the bottom of this down entry

explanation.surface: A communist leader in a red cape that is torn at the hem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Red' looks like a political label after Mao; it is the wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Mâcon is a Burgundy wine, made in red as well as white.

clue.text: Write chapter in story "A Defence against Demons"?

parts.note: a pen is what you write with, and to pen is to write

indicators.note: in means the chapter's letter sits inside the story's word

parts.note: a tale is a story

explanation.surface: An author pens a chapter for a fantasy tale titled A Defence against Demons.
explanation.definitionFit: A pentacle is a five-pointed star used in magic as a protective charm to ward off evil spirits.

clue.text: A little bit of information shortly turning up

indicators.note: turning up means read upward, backwards in this down entry
shortly means cut short, so the last letter goes

parts.note: data means information

explanation.surface: A small scrap of information arrives soon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortly' trims DATA to DAT, and 'turning up' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tad is an informal word for a very small amount.

clue.text: Cynic heartlessly keeping our redeveloped hotel for a squat

indicators.note: keeping means holding, so the remaining letters of cynic hold the reworked letters
heartlessly means the word loses everything between its first and last letters
redeveloped means rebuilt, so the letters of our are rearranged

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A cynic sneers at a hotel redevelopment that sits on top of a squat.
explanation.definitionFit: A crouch is a low bent-legged posture, the same position as a squat.

clue.text: Promise of power, large advantage

parts.note: P is the physics abbreviation for power
an edge is an advantage

explanation.surface: A politician's promise of power gives a big advantage.
explanation.definitionFit: A pledge is a solemn undertaking or vow, a formal promise.

clue.text: The tanks destroyed Asian city

indicators.note: destroyed means wrecked, so the letters of the and tanks are smashed and rearranged

explanation.surface: A war report: an enemy's tanks wrecked in an Asian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Tashkent is the capital of Uzbekistan in Central Asia.
